description: Updated D094 unapproved comparison batch with S002 guru-shishya and crossed aranis plus repaired S005 two-arm sleeper and corrected muted-brown skin; all ten landscape candidates require fresh independent review against the final plan.
review_notice: Unapproved landscape candidates for comparison only. The frozen plan shows a generic seated guru and attentive disciple beside S002’s two crossed aranis; S002 v004 retains both sticks and has producer-counted anatomy with skin-only R-B 109–114. S005 v008 replaces v005 after the captain’s extra-arm finding and v007 after a skin-color-only correction; producer inspection counts one generic sleeper with exactly two arms and records cheek/torso R-B 112/114. Earlier S002 v002/v003 and S005 v006/v007 are preserved as history and are not visible alternates. Because the plan and selected images changed, fresh independent exact-checksum review is pending for all ten selected candidates. Prior known deviations for S003 v009, S004 v017, S006 v012, S008 v007 and S009 v005 remain disclosed; S006, S008 and S009 skin samples include values above plan targets as documented in their candidate_status. Captions 1–10 remain mapped faithfully; photos 011–014 remain unmapped extras. Portrait production remains paused. Producer inspection is separate from independent review and no artwork is approved.
visual_review_status: producer-reviewed; fresh independent full exact-checksum review pending for all ten selected landscape candidates after the plan revision

rows.scene: A single all-pervading presence and varied flames evoke the chapter’s first teaching.
rows.candidate_status: Three groups of distinct logs carry small, medium and large flames against the cosmic spiral; no people or text appear. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The guru instructs an attentive seated disciple beside the two crossed aranis.
rows.candidate_status: Exactly two generic seated figures: the older guru faces and instructs the attentive disciple beside the two crossed aranis; both logs remain distinct beneath a small fire and separate branch tangle. At native and enlarged views each figure has one head, two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet; visible hands show five digits and each of four bare feet shows five toes. Skin-only 11x11 medians: guru cheek (545,217) RGB (150,76,38) R-B 112; torso (410,320) (153,77,39) R-B 114; disciple cheek (1280,215) (152,80,43) R-B 109; torso (1295,315) (152,78,40) R-B 112. No readable text. Producer reviewed; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri turns from temporary remedies toward Bhagwan’s refuge.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri turns toward Bhagwan with folded hands; the image shows him kneeling with folded lower legs rather than seated as specified. One exposed foot shows five toes; the other is tucked; Bhagwan’s visible open blessing hand shows five digits and both visible feet show five toes. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: warm-brown skin target is R-B below 120. Independent reviewer’s skin-only 11x11 patches, using crop-origin coordinates, measured cheek origin (350,310) RGB (184,104,58) R-B 126 and torso origin (280,480) RGB (187,111,66) R-B 121. My exact-check remeasurement at the same origins matched. Additional skin-only origins: cheek (360,320) RGB (180,101,54) R-B 126; upper arm/torso (250,490) RGB (155,80,42) R-B 113. These two reviewer patches exceed target; no regeneration because repair rounds are exhausted. Producer reinspection needs-fix; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Even the highest celestial realm is unsettled; the poet seeks refuge and release.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri’s head, eyes and folded prayer hands face Bhagwan at right; both legs and feet are naturally tucked beneath the dhoti and not visible. Brahma has four distinct heads and four attached arms; Bhagwan’s visible open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: sampled 11x11 cheek patch RGB medians (194,111,71), (186,107,72), (180,97,60) have R-B 123/114/120; torso patch RGB medians (210,124,82), (201,124,91), (200,115,75) have R-B 128/110/125. The brown-skin target is under about 120; sampled face/torso patch medians are 120/125. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: One tree holds both dream and waking; the corrected two-arm sleeper rests on its shadowed branch.
rows.candidate_status: One generic reclining sleeper rests on the shadowed branch of the same connected tree; the open waking branch and lotus remain. Native view and enlarged body/arm crops show exactly two attached arms: one bends to the temple and one rests along the lower torso/tree branch. The image contains no deity or second person. One head, two legs, two feet, five toes on each visible foot; the branch-side hand shows thumb plus four fingers, while the temple-side thumb is partly occluded against the head. Skin-only 11x11 medians: cheek origin (235,370) RGB (162,92,50), R-B 112; torso/arm origin (320,445) (164,91,50), R-B 114, within the approximate under-120 target. No readable text. Producer review pass; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri offers his mind in devotion and receives the guru’s word.
rows.candidate_status: Bhattathiri's required off-white sacred thread remains visible from left shoulder to right waist. The viewer-left deity foot now shows five clearly separated toes; the other visible deity foot shows five. Bhattathiri's exposed foot shows five; the other is tucked. His namaste has five visible fingertip ends with thumbs overlapped. Guruvayurappan's two open hands each show thumb plus four fingers. Bhattathiri 11x11 skin-only medians: cheek origin (390,300) RGB (161,84,47) R-B 114; torso (360,420) (195,107,65) R-B 130; arm (390,470) (141,75,40) R-B 101. Additional skin windows at (385,350) R-B 124, (320,460) 129, (420,480) 129, (435,500) 121, (460,500) 132, and (390,520) 130. DISCLOSED DEVIATION: several warm-brown skin patches exceed the plan's R-B target of about 120; these are recorded, not concealed. Guruvayurappan face/torso B-R samples are 41/59. One of each figure; no readable text or rays/beams. Producer review pass with disclosed skin deviation; fresh independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: An unmarked scripture and a healthy unmilked cow recall labor without devotion.
rows.candidate_status: Open, completely blank palm-leaf manuscript shows a clear two-leaf spread beside a healthy cow; the enlarged lower-body view shows four attached legs ending in four hooves. The empty bowl and silent flower remain. No letters, symbols, people or deity. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri worships Bhagwan and follows the footprints of the beloved devotees.
rows.candidate_status: DISCLOSED DEVIATION: Bhattathiri’s warm-brown skin target is R-B below about 120. Independent reviewer’s skin-only 11x11 patch medians: face (380,345) RGB (197,115,63), R-B 134; torso (300,500) RGB (166,90,45), R-B 121; arm (475,540) RGB (201,118,67), R-B 134. My exact remeasurement at the same crop origins matched; the prior producer arm value was R-B 132 at a different sample. Both open hands show thumb plus four fingers; one visible bare foot has five toes and the other is tucked; Bhagwan’s visible hands and feet show the expected digits/toes. Full-bleed scene has one Bhattathiri and one Bhagwan with the required footprints and no frame. Producer reinspection pass with disclosed skin deviation; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: Bhattathiri serves at the temple while worshipping the four-armed Bhagwan.
rows.candidate_status: DISCLOSED DEVIATION: warm-brown skin target is R-B below 120. ImageMagick 11x11 median patches are reported by upper-left crop origin. Independent reviewer values, reproduced exactly: cheek origin (420,170) RGB (172,88,49), R-B 123; chest (390,260) RGB (178,90,52), R-B 126; forearm (470,360) RGB (180,94,56), R-B 124. Producer reinspection needs-fix; independent exact-checksum re-review pending; no artwork approval.

rows.scene: The gopikas’ loving circle around Krishna expresses the devotion he honors.
rows.candidate_status: Gopika face skin-only patch medians R-B 97, 99, 116 and 118; Krishna face/torso B-R 88/87. Krishna forehead is bare apart from one low band and feather; all ten visible hands show thumb plus four fingers, and each of eight visible gopika feet plus Krishna’s visible foot show five toes. Independent exact-checksum review pending; no artwork approval.
